LanguageData.Rimverse_Threat_Desc: Multiplies the threat budget of Rimverse fleets, pirates and events.
LanguageData.Rimverse_Economy_Desc: Multiplies Rimverse prices, colony income and upkeep.
LanguageData.Rimverse_ResearchCost_Desc: Multiplies the cost of Rimverse research projects.
LanguageData.Rimverse_DebugLogging_Desc: Writes extra messages to the log to help find problems.
LanguageData.Rimverse_NewGameOnly: Generation options only apply to new universes.
LanguageData.Rimverse_GalaxyCount_Desc: How many galaxies the universe generates at game start.
LanguageData.Rimverse_StarDensity_Desc: How many stars each region of a galaxy has, compared to the real density (0.004 stars per cubic light-year). Lower values make maps lighter and space emptier.
LanguageData.Rimverse_CivSimulation_Desc: Civilizations grow, trade, wage war and fall even far from your colony.
LanguageData.Rimverse_CivTickInterval_Desc: How often civilizations update. Higher values cost less performance.
LanguageData.Rimverse_AirConsumption_Desc: Multiplies how much air each colonist uses aboard.
LanguageData.Rimverse_FuelConsumption_Desc: Multiplies fuel and warp matter used when travelling.
LanguageData.Rimverse_BreachDrain_Desc: Multiplies how fast a breach drains a room's air.
LanguageData.Rimverse_ShipCombat_Desc: Allows space battles between ships and fleets.
LanguageData.Rimverse_FluxoEnabled_Desc: Turns on the Great Flow power system, its orders and beam blades.
LanguageData.Rimverse_FluxoChance_Desc: Chance for a new pawn to be sensitive to the Great Flow.
LanguageData.Rimverse_QolEnabled_Desc: Turns on Rimverse quality of life features. Each one turns itself off when its original mod is active.
LanguageData.Rimverse_QolNone: No quality of life features installed.
LanguageData.Rimverse_OdysseyIntegration_Desc: Uses Odyssey content inside Rimverse. Rimverse ships stay their own system.
LanguageData.Rimverse_CEIntegration_Desc: Converts Rimverse weapons, armor and ammo to Combat Extended.
LanguageData.Rimverse_EndlessRoomsEvents_Desc: Enables the events, powers and scenario linking the universe to the Endless Rooms backrooms.
